goal.objective: `src/paginate.js` is wrong and `node --test test/*.test.js` fails. Fix `paginate(items, page, size)` so pages are 1-based, `pages` is the number of pages needed to hold every item (0 for an empty list), pages past the last are empty, the input is never mutated, and a non-positive or fractional page or size throws a RangeError. Change only files under src/. Do not modify anything under test/ or package.json, and add no dependencies: node_modules must not exist. The standard is `node --test test/*.test.js` passing in the workspace root.
